prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1249; do not mention it.)
text:
We represent the injured party in connection with the motor vehicle collision described above, which involved a low-speed head-on impact. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for them. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or any other means.

Kindly provide the policy limits of liability coverage under the policy issued to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits. We also ask that you confirm in writing whether any other coverage may apply to this loss.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, witness statements, claim notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any correspondence with other parties. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or repaired in a manner that would destroy their evidentiary value while this claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
